news.title: Bitcoin plunges below $66,000 as global stocks, AI trades hit fresh records
news.summary: BTC plunged 6.4% to a 24-hour low of $65,708 and ether broke below $1,900 in Asian trading on Wednesday, just hours after the MSCI All Country World Index set a fresh all-time high on the AI rally.

news.title: Bullish crypto bets lose $1.6 billion as ETH, SOL, DOGE drop 9%
news.summary: The single biggest unwind was a $59.67 million BTC-USDT long on HTX.

news.title: Bitcoin's 'fear gauge' surges nearly 20%, its biggest jump since Feb. 5 crash
news.summary: The jump signals return of fear after two months of calm market sentiment.

news.title: Prediction market traders bet bitcoin's selloff has further to run
news.summary: Markets now imply a 66% chance bitcoin falls below $55,000 and a coin-flip chance of sub-$50,000 prices before year-end.

news.title: Franklin Templeton says Wall Street fears blockchain because it threatens its profits
news.summary: Jenny Johnson, Franklin Templeton's CEO, said blockchain and crypto threaten a huge number of business models that exist today in traditional finance.
